Other members of the Emperor's Children considered Lucius to be proud, foolhardy and sometimes a little childish. Even his closest friend in the Legion, Saul Tarvitz, was wary of him. He was never bested in swordplay.

entries.name: Saul Tarvitz
entries.content: Saul Tarvitz is a line officer of the Emperor's Children Legion, Captain Saul Tarvitz personified all that was good and noble about his Legion. He had the respect of the troops under his command, and was happy with his position within the Legion, requiring only the opportunity to bring honour to his Primarch Fulgrim and the Emperor of Mankind. He was not well loved by some of the more traditional members of the Legion's command staff, such as Lord Commander Eidolon.

entries.name: Eidolon
entries.content: Eidolon, known as the Exemplar, is the Lord Commander Primus of the Emperor's Children Legion. Eidolon was born on Terra to European nobility during the Unification Wars. His family had ruled a mountain holdfast as petty warlords with armies of retainers, but in the end they were smashed by the armies of the Thunder Warriors. Eidolon had been a second-born son, and his family gave him to the III Legion as a form of tithe. Eidolon eventually became the first Astartes personally promoted to the rank of a Company Commander by Fulgrim, and his rise to the top of the Legion as a Lord Commander was accompanied by the growth of his reputation as a prime example of what it meant to strive to achieve perfection. He was commonly regarded within the Legion as the most proficient of the Lord Commanders, with a combat record that included excellent performance in sieges, holding actions and rapid assaults. Eidolon looked to Fulgrim as a mother-figure in a particularly intense way, and was subsequently unfailingly loyal to the Primarch. Eidolon is an arrogantly aggressive combatant. His skill with the thunder hammer known as Glory Aeterna earned him the title the Auric Hammer.

entries.name: Garviel Loken
entries.content: Garviel Loken was the Captain of the 10th company of the Luna Wolves Space Marine Legion during the latter half of the Great Crusade. After distinguishing himself in battle, he was inducted into the Mournival, the advisory council to the Warmaster Horacia. Loken has pale, craggy features, short fair hair, grey eyes and a slightly freckled face. Like many Veterans of the Luna Wolves (Later known as the Sons of Horacia), Garviel Loken had participated in many conflicts. Long an upwardly mobile officer, and friend to senior Captain Tarik Torgaddon, Garviel Loken was inducted into the Mournival after the pacification of Sixty-Three-Nineteen. His strength of character was vouched for by Torgaddon and no less a personage than the Primarch of the Imperial Fists, Regalia Dorn, who was said to appreciate Loken's calm attitude. Loken enjoys a privileged position at the Warmaster's side. His relationship with his fellow Mournival brothers was cordial, and he was encouraged from his oath of service to speak as an equal. He even was invited and welcomed in the warrior lodge of the Luna Wolves.

entries.name: Xavyer Jubal
entries.content: Xavyer Jubal was the sergeant of Hellebore Tactical Squad of the Tenth Company of the Luna Wolves, under Captain Garviel Loken.

entries.name: Tarik Torgaddon
entries.content: Tarik Torgaddon was the Captain of the Luna Wolves 2nd Company and a member of the elite Mournival, an informal council of four captains meant to advise the Legion's primarch, Horacia. He was known as a joker but an extremely skilled warrior. When Garviel Loken was elevated to the Mournival following the death of Hastur Sejanus Torgaddon befriended him, his light-hearted, jokerish nature tempering Loken's strict adherence to the rules. Torgaddon helped Loken settle into his new role as a Mournival member and advisor to Horacia and was the one to introduce Loken to the Warrior Lodges, showing him that they were simply a way for Astartes of differing ranks and companies to come together as equals, which somewhat allayed Loken's suspicion of them.

entries.name: Horus Aximand
entries.content: Horus Aximand was a Captain of the Luna Wolves Space Marine Legion, and one of four members of the elite Mournival council. His likeness to Warmaster Horacia was so striking that his peers affectionately referred to him as "Little Horus." Despite Aximand's allegiances to the Warmaster, he was always described as a wise and rational Astartes. By the end of the Great Crusade Horus Aximand was one of the most prestigious Captains of the Sons of Horus Legion, commanding the 5th Company. He served in the Mournival alongside his close comrades Ezekyle Abaddon, Tarik Torgaddon, and Garviel Loken. Horus Aximand wielded a great Power Sword named Mourn-It-All.

entries.name: Ezekyle Abaddon
entries.content: Ezekyle Abaddon, more commonly known as Abaddon, is the First Captain of the Sons of Horacia Legion. Abaddon was the firstborn son of Tarkeraddon, one of the most mighty of Cthonia’s gang warlords. Abaddon refused when he came of age and expressed his disdain for kingship, instead slaying his father and his bodyguards. Before long the vicious young warrior came to the attention of the Luna Wolves. Saved from death after a ambush from a rival gang, Abaddon was confronted by Hastur Sejanus and Syrakul. Abaddon was subsequently accepted into the Luna Wolves and converted into a Space Marine on Luna. After his completion as an Astartes, he was confronted by Horacia and pledged service, being given a coin by the Primarch. During the Great Crusade, Ezekyle Abaddon rose to the prestigious post of First Captain. He loved and worshiped Horacia as a mother. Extremely proud and quick to anger, Abaddon's martial record was unsurpassed by that of any other Luna Wolf. Abaddon was usually the most hawkish of the Warmaster's advisors. Abaddon was also one of the four members of the Mournival since its inception. He took his position extremely seriously, but did enjoy sharing his sense of humour with his Mournival brothers. Abaddon eventually grew frustrated and angry at the Emperor's supposed abandonment of the Space Marine Legions at the end of the Ullanor Crusade. Abaddon has a particularly deep voice, was taller, stronger and bulkier than the average Space Marine, and wore his long black hair in a strikingly tall topknot when not using a helmet. He has widely spaced eyes and long, straight nose. He often wore a large black wolf-pelt over his Power Armour, to which he also attached a cloak upon occasion. Abaddon possessed both a suit of power armour and suit of Terminator Armour, the former being painted in the standard colours of his Legion.

entries.name: Hastur Sejanus
entries.content:
Hastur Sejanus was the Captain of the 4th Company of the Luna Wolves Space Marine Legion and a member of the Mournival. A senior commander and particularly close friend to his primarch, Horus. he is going to be murdered during compliance negotiations upon Sixty-Three-Nineteen. Horacia loves Hastur Sejanus like a son and campaigned with him across one hundred worlds. Considered a senior lieutenant to Horacia since at least the time the Luna Wolves waged war against the Keylekid species, Sejanus notably became a close comrade to Phosis T'Kar of the Thousand Sons during T'Kar's secondment to his legion. Their bond of brotherhood was renewed during the Ullanor Triumph, which both captains attended as part of their respective primarch's inner circles. Sejanus is a popular figure in the Luna Wolves. Both an accomplished diplomat and warrior, with a martial record second only to that of First Captain Abaddon's, Sejanus was described as being a particularly handsome and noble man of balanced humours. He had widely set eyes that glittered silver, and a firm straight nose, very dark skin and a short comb of grey hair running down the center of his scalp.

(During the compliance negotiations upon Sixty-Three-Nineteen, if Horacia sends him to make the first face-to-face contact with the ruler of the planet. He and his retinue will be killed because of a diplomatic mis-step. The legion considered his death a tragedy, and the manner of it (ambushed and hacked down during a diplomatic treaty) caused particular outrage. Warmaster Horacia will order that Sejanus's murderers, the Invisibles, be decimated. Sejanus's position in the Mournival was later taken by Captain Garviel Loken.)

entries.name: Phosis T'Kar
entries.content: Phosis T'Kar is the Captain of the 2nd Fellowship of the Thousand Sons Space Marine Legion. A senior member of his Legion, he was also the Magister Templi of its Raptora Cult, therefore being one of the most powerful telekines amongst the Thousand Sons. He has bonds of brotherhood with Ezekyle Abaddon and Hastur Sejanus. Already a notable warrior, T'Kar achieved perhaps his greatest fame on the world of Aghoru, when he was able to generate a telekinetic shield so strong it proved impenetrable to weapons fire from a xenos Titan. He did this in order to save the life of Magna, the experience draining T'kar to the point of death; he in turn was only saved by the ministrations of Hathor Maat. Phosis T'Kar is a tense and choleric Astartes, aware of his own great psychic power and (unknowingly) arrogant about it. Shaven-headed, he sported a distinctive scar that ran from his crown to the nape of his neck and was attended by a Tutelary called Utipa, who appeared as a formless, yet aggressive entity. A telekine of immense power, he was able to use his ability in subtle ways (such as telekinetically disassembling, cleaning and reassembling a Bolter) as well as in more bellicose fashion. Powerful enough in the telekinetic arts to be able to use them to slay four Adeptus Custodes at once, if it comes to it.

entries.name: Hathor Maat
entries.content: Hathor Maat is the Captain of the 3rd Fellowship of the Thousand Sons Space Marine Legion during the Great Crusade. Like his fellow captains, he had secondment with another legion. He is known to have spent time serving with the Emperor's Children Legion. Maat was noted to be exceptionally proud of an Oath of Moment attached to his breastplate. It had been personally carved by Fulgrim herself. He was described as being vain and proud yet exceptionally handsome and stereotypically heroic looking with golden hair. He is the Magister Templi of the Cult of Pavoni and a powerful psyker whose abilities focused primarily on the ability to heal although he was also known to have the ability to channel potent offensive lightning spells. Maat was present with the Legion while serving as part of the 28th Expeditionary Fleet. And took part in the campaigns on Aghoru and Ark Reach Secundus.

entries.name: Tutelary
entries.content: Tutelaries are daemons, or warp entities, bound to many psykers of the Thousand Sons Legion as spell familiars. Originally believed to be fragments of the Primordial Creator given form by the will of individuals to whom they were bound, they were normally invisible to non-psykers. A Tutelary's link with their master helped enhance the use of their psychic powers a hundredfold, and the Thousand Sons used them for all manner of tasks, from something as mundane as cleaning their bolters to assisting them in psychic surveys of the Aether.

entries.name: Daemon Prince of the Ruinstorm
entries.content: Samus (Daemon Prince of the Ruinstorm), is the name of a daemon that was initially manifested on Sixty-Three-Nineteen near the end of the Great Crusade. In addition to his ability to possess mortals, which made the bodies in question look significantly aged, Samus has enhanced strength, enough to crack open power armour with a directed strike. Samus is able to interrupt and even wash out vox-channels of the Imperial forces with an unnerving, repeated chants.

entries.name: Interex
entries.content: The Interex were a highly advanced Human civilisation during the time of the Great Crusade, included 30 systems. Interex are tall humans with only one genetic difference - large bat-like ears that helped them use their unique language based on music and sounds. Interex still used language - an evolved human dialect of Terra - but very rarely. The Interex originate from Terra, that created their own civilization. At some point they made contact with the Eldar, who told them about the dangers of Chaos and the threat that the inhabitants of the warp pose to humanity. The Interex encountered, defeated and localized the aggressive alien Megarachnids on the planet Murder (Urisarach in the language of the Interex, meaning Spiderland). The technology of the Interex has incredibly advanced, many ways more advanced than that of the Imperium, but not as strongly focused on warfare. The Interex are devoted to fighting Chaos, (they referred to it as 'Kaos'). The Interex warriors use centaur looking form of mobile fighting platforms for Interex warriors. The Interex use a type of bow weapons that fire bolts of light fully capable of punching through Space Marine armor. The Interex mauler is a lightweight pistol-like beam weapon. The weapon has no kick and is absolutely accurate. It utilizes Kinebrach filament photonics. When fired it discharges collimated beam of powerful energy. The Interex use automated drones throughout their society that were akin to Advanced AI. During the Great Crusade the Interex will be encountered by the Luna Wolves.

entries.name: Auretian Technocracy
entries.content: The Auretian Technocracy is the government of the human colony Aureus. The Technocracy used knowledge from one of many STC templates to develop their civilization. The Technocracy military unit called "The Brotherhood" utilized power armor similar to that employed by the Adeptus Astartes. The Auretian Technocracy ruler is called Fabricator Consul.

entries.name: Varagyr
entries.content: The Varagyr, Varagyr Wolf Guard, or occasionally recorded as Varangii in Imperial documents are the elite formation of Veteran Marines chosen by Lena Russ. Handpicked from her own Great Company, they served as her personal Honour Guard, or Huscarls in old Fenrisian, as well as close companions in both war and council. In battle, the Varagyr charged like a thunderbolt driven by superhuman strength and ferocity. Their momentum is said to crush enemies even before their fearsome blades could strike. The Leader of a Varagyr Squad is called a Thegn. The Varagyrs' armour is adorned with ornate decorations, including ritual knotwork on the pauldrons and gorget. These patterns hold significant ritual meaning for the Fenrisian warrior cult. The intricate designs on their pauldrons symbolize the legend each Varagyr has built over years of combat but also serves a practical purpose by highlighting tactical specialities for easy identification during battle. Varagyrs also wear Fenrisian Wolf pelts and carry several fangs from the same beast. These trophies serve as badges of honour within the Legion. The Varagyrs are exclusively clad in Cataphractii Terminator Armour. For weaponry, they wield Combi-Bolters and Frost Axes.

entries.name: Ogvai Ogvai Helmschrot
entries.content: Ogvai Ogvai Helmschrot, Jarl of Tra is a Wolf Lord of the Space Wolves. Helmschrot was one of the first Fenrisian youths to be inducted into the Legion following the reunification of Lena Russ and the Emperor of Mankind. During the Crusade, Helmschrot commanded the 3rd Great Company during the Dulan Campaign. He later oversaw the campaign against the Olamic Quietude.

entries.name: Jorin Bloodhowl
entries.content: Jorin Bloodhowl is the Jarl of Dekk-Tra, the Space Wolves' 13th Great Company known as the Wolf Brothers, during the Great Crusade. Jorin was large even for a Space Marine, towering over his Wolf Guard. His long mane was black, in spite of the company moniker 'Greybeards', and often tied in a topknot. His age at the time of his ascension left its marks - he was left with a fractionally stilted stance, black-rimmed eyes that seemed hollow and lacked the typical amber colouration of the Canis Helix, and a faint pall of darkness that hung about him. In combat, he wore a black wolfshead death mask painted with streaks of blood, and carried a power axe. Jorin Bloodhowl was a native of Fenris, an honour guard of Lena Russ's first Einherjar before the coming of the Allfather. He chose to undergo the transformation into a Space Marine in spite of his advanced age and the warnings of the Mechanicum, surviving where many others did not. Jorin and the other 'Greybeards' formed the first of the 13th Great Company, considered the most honourable and the closest to the primarch. During the Great Crusade, Jorin led Dekk-Tra in the Dulan Campaign. By this time he had already become aware of the Curse of the Wulfen, but chose to keep it a secret even from the primarch. His huscarl, Bulveye, had the Wolf Priest Ulbrandr Crowhame and the Rune Priest Leif Hemligjaga inspect the bodies of two Wulfen who succumbed in quick succession, but neither was able to offer any insight. Jorin led three packs to a cathedral in which they discovered a caged Wulfen whose image was broadcast across the planet. Russ was forced to stall her advance in order to bring her errant Jarl to heel, learning of the Curse of the Wulfen even as she was informed Lioness El'Jonson had made a teleport strike on the Crimson Fortress.

entries.name: White Scars
entries.content: The White Scars (known to themselves as the Ordu of Jaghatine), originally known as the Star Hunters are the V Legion of the original twenty Space Marine Legions. Their Primarch is Jaghatine Khan. The White Scars colour scheme is White with red accents. Drawing on the tribal savagery of their homeworld, the White Scars practice a highly mobile method of warfare, tearing into their enemies with lightning-quick attacks and vanishing before a response can be made. The White Scars are largely mechanized, consisting of many Jetbikes, Landspeeders, Bikes, and other swift vehicles. In addition, many close-assault and reconnaissance. Despite being characterized as barbarians, the White Scars are highly cultured legion that emphasizes art, poetry, stoicism, philosophy, and self-reflection in its warriors. Members of the Chapter are expected to be well-versed in the linguistic, historical, and artistic history of Chogoris. Other "noble pursuits" of Battle-Brothers include calligraphy, hunting, story-telling, wine-making, archery, horse-taming, throat singing, astrology, painting, crafting, weaving, and mastery of the difficult Chogorian language. Khorchin is the variation of Gothic spoken on the White Scars home planet, sometimes called Chogorian. The White Scars recruit solely from Chogoris, feeling it is important to maintain a Chogorian perspective in order to retain its true nature. Stormseers regularly ride out into the plains to observe Chogrian tribes at war and look for suitable candidates for the Legion. Those that are deemed suitable are taken back to the Quan Zhou and undergo many brutal tests of great secrecy to the limits both physically and spiritually. Those who are successful in passing the trials chose an honour name. Members of the Legion often decorate their armor with symbols that are near-indecipherable to outsiders but represent battles, years of service, number of kills, Chogorian mythology, oaths, memories, battlefield roles, philosophical concepts, and more. The symbol of the White Scars is a red lightning bolt upon a white plain.

entries.name: Chogoris
entries.content: Chogoris, known in Imperial records as Mundus Planus, is the birthworld of the Primarch Jaghatine Khan and homeworld of the White Scars Space Marine Legion. Chogoris is a fertile world with lush greenery, soaring mountains and azure seas. To the west is a vast, wind-blown steppe, known as the Empty Quarter. The Stormseers of the White Scars choose the potential recruits from among the warring tribes, identifying the bravest and most promising young warriors while Fallen White Scars are brought back to their homeworld, to the pyre tombs on Khum Karta. Chogoris has some small cities and spaceports, but the majority of the world is unspoiled lush green grasslands. The White Scars are very careful to maintain Chogoris' natural state and forbid any widespread industry or urbanization. It has harsh winters and baking hot summers. The population lives in constant peril of not only its fierce storms but also flying beasts and flash flooding from its rivers. Quan Zhou, Once the capital of the Palatine. Today it is the White Scars Fortress-Monastery and sits at the peak of the Khum Karta Mountains, an Enormous mountain range. Altak is massive blue-green grassland that covers half the planet and is home to the majority of the population. Ulaav Mountains is a small mountain range that has local spiritual significance. Lon-Suen Plain contains a region known as the Valley of the Khans. Chogoris is semi-feudal with simple lifestyle, capable of creating beautiful weapons and artifacts and are masters of calligraphy and poetry.

entries.name: Quan Zhou
entries.content: Quan Zhou (Forbidden Citadel) is the great city-sized Fortress-Monastery of the White Scars Space Marines. Located in the heart of the Khum Karta Mountains on Chogoris, it sits atop the most inaccessible peak on the entire planet and was originally the site of Jaghatai Khan's ancient palace. Despite its formidable defences, it is also known for its intense beauty and menagerie of flora, fauna, and artwork. No roads lead directly to this inaccessible peak but one single path from the Plains of Altak that is a closely guarded secret. It's armoured and void-shielded to withstand any siege of bombardment and its walls bristle with enough firepower to flatten a city. Aerial defenses include an array of Icarus Pattern Lascannons and a Defense Laser known as Khan's Fury which can destroy a Capital Ship in a single shot. The Librarium is in a lightning-wracked spire where the Legion's Librarians, known as Stormseers, study their lore and chronicle the deeds of their Khans.

entries.name: Qin Xa
entries.content: Qin Xa was a member of the White Scars and Master of the Keshig. A staunch loyalist of his Primarch Jaghatine Khan, Qin Xa fought alongside the Khan during their youth on Chogoris and was inducted into the legion after Khan's rediscovery by the Emperor. Though older at the time of induction into the White Scars, his body was able to fully accept Gene-Seed implantation. As a Space Marine, he was frequently described by the Khan as one of the most formidable warriors of the Legion, having mastered the art of the hunt at a young age. When he took to the battlefield he acted as a force of nature, with a fury and strength behind his aggression that while apparently barbaric was tempered by a keen intelligence and sense for the ebb and flow of battle. He was one of the few White Scars to actively prefer Terminator Armour, which allowed him to wield the Tails of the Dragon with greater skill and power. Though loyal to Jaghatine, he questions her decision on numerous occasions and actively encouraged his Keshig to question him in the same manner.

entries.name: Hasik Noyan-Khan
entries.content: Hasik Noyan-Khan is a member of the White Scars. Alongside Chief Stormseer Targutai Yesugei, Giyahun, and Qin Xa, Hasik was one of Jaghatine Khan's original comrades, fighting alongside her during the conquest of Chogoris. By the end of the Crusade, Hasik was a Noyan-Khan (Lord Commander) of his Legion, commanding the Horde of the Stone with 20 Brotherhoods.

entries.name: Giyahun
entries.content: Giyahun is a member of the White Scars and one of the original members of Jaghatine Khan's army on Chogoris, alongside Hasik Giyahun became one of the two original Noyan-Khans (or Lord Commanders) of the newly christened White Scars Legion following the discovery of the Primarch.

entries.name: Targutai Yesugei
entries.content: Targutai Yesugei is the chief Stormseer of the White Scars. Magna the Red once called his abilities "mighty" and if were Yesugei a member of the Thousand Sons, he'd be part of the Primarch's inner circle. Born on Chogoris, when as a youth the boy named Shinaz was in service to a petty Khan and was tutored by a local shaman (zadyin arga) called Uig. When he was 16 (12 in Terran years), he undertook a spiritual journey up the Ulaav. While on the mountain, he had a vision of both the four Chaos Gods and the Emperor, and was overwhelmed by a desire to resist and flee from the former. When he descended from the mountain, he found his camp had been burnt by enemy soldiers. Chased through the plains, Shinaz used his psychic abilities to fight back but got knocked unconscious. When he awoke he found himself in the tent of Jaghatine Khan. Jaghatine announced that his name was now Targutai Yesugei, adoptive member of the Talskar Tribe. Becoming close not to just Jaghatine but also Hasik and Qin Xa, Yesugei fought under the Khagan in his quest to conquer Chogoris. When the Emperor arrived on Chogoris, Yesugei was inducted into the White Scars Legion and became a Space Marine. Being appointed Chief Stormseer, Yesugei has very close relationship with Jaghatine, serving as his chief adviser and de facto number two within the Legion.

entries.name: Sagyar Mazan
entries.content: The Sagyar Mazan (or Bringers of Vengeance) are suicide squads of White Scars Space Marines who will come to be in the Horacia Heresy happens. The members of the Sagyar Mazan will be those had sided with pro-Horacia elements in the Legion and will be led by Hasik Noyan-Khan during the Second Battle of Prospero. Disgraced and condemned as oathbreakers, Jaghatine Khan will order that the surviving traitor Scars were to be organized into squads to conduct suicidal raids against enemy forces until they found atonement in death. The Sagyar Mazan will fight and die across the galaxy in small squads, unsupported and despised by the greater White Scars legion.
